tagline.zh: 远程输出与宠物伙伴，单人体验顺滑。
tagline.en: Ranged damage with a pet companion; smooth solo play.

strengths.zh: 单人练级轻松，宠物可承担前排。
strengths.en: Easy solo leveling with a pet up front.

drawbacks.zh: 需要管理宠物，近战距离弱势。
drawbacks.en: Pet management overhead; weak in melee range.
